pick_device.title: Select Discovered Aqara G100
pick_device.description: Automatic LAN scan found the following camera candidate(s). Select one or choose manual IP entry.

data_description.selected_host: Choose one of the cameras automatically discovered on your local network, or select manual IP entry.

manual.title: Configure Camera
manual.description: Enter the camera IP address and the RTSP credentials enabled in the Aqara Home app (**Camera Settings → More Settings → LAN RTSP Preview**). Detailed hints are shown directly under each field.

data_description.camera_ip: Aqara Home App -> Camera Settings -> Network Information -> IP Address.
data_description.rtsp_username: Aqara Home App -> Camera Settings -> More Settings -> LAN RTSP Preview -> Username (or username in rtsp://user:pass@ip:8554/ch1).
data_description.rtsp_password: Aqara Home App -> Camera Settings -> More Settings -> LAN RTSP Preview -> Password.
data_description.rtsp_port: Aqara Home App -> More Settings -> LAN RTSP Preview (default 8554).
data_description.default_channel: ch1 = 2K High (2304x1296), works only when Apple HomeKit is disabled on the camera (with HomeKit enabled it drops to 1080p); ch2 = Medium (640x360); ch3 = Low.
data_description.idle_sleep_snapshot: When enabled and no live viewer is open, prevents background dashboard cards from waking the camera every ~10 seconds for still snapshots, keeping the G100 in standby.

aqara_account.title: Aqara Home App Sync (Optional)
aqara_account.description: Sign in with your Aqara Home account to unlock hardware controls and AI sensors not exposed over local RTSP alone. Enables: real App Privacy Mode (hardware sleep), Status LED, Flash / Spotlight, Night Vision, Motion / Person / Pet / Face / Vehicle / Package / Fire / Sound detections (with sensitivity & intervals), Speaker Volume, camera voice language, OSD timestamp/watermark/box options, anti-theft lock, Wi-Fi signal strength, and hardware status. Leave Email and Password blank to use LAN RTSP video and Talkback only (unsupported cloud entities stay hidden).

data_description.aqara_email: Email registered in the Aqara Home app. Leave blank together with password to keep LAN-only RTSP and local Talkback.
data_description.aqara_password: Password for your Aqara Home account to authenticate advanced camera controls and AI detection events.
data_description.aqara_region: Regional Aqara server where your account is registered (must match the region used in the Aqara Home app).
data_description.aqara_device_id: Unique hardware camera ID (lumi3.xxx), auto-detected via local mDNS or your account. Keep as-is unless instructed by the diagnostic scan.
